'''Ethanol''' was the main ingredient in [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages.<ref name="Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref> One example was [[talmog]], which consisted of one part spiced ethanol and one part [[Lyme's rose juice]].<ref name="Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>
